value.notes: Controlled; an array gives a range slider with one Thumb per entry.

defaultValue.notes: Uncontrolled; defaults to min when omitted.

onValueChange.notes: reason: 'input-change' | 'track-press' | 'drag' | 'keyboard' | 'none'; details include activeThumbIndex and a cloned event whose target.value/target.name are set for form libraries.

onValueCommitted.notes: Generic (non-change) event; does not fire if the value did not change or the change was cancelled.

name/form.notes: name identifies the field for submission; the hidden range inputs inherit it.

largeStep.notes: Used by Page Up/Page Down and Shift+Arrow.

minStepsBetweenValues.notes: Range sliders: minimum gap between adjacent thumbs.

Thumb.index.notes: Required for SSR of multi-thumb sliders; must match the value array index. Emits data-index.

Thumb.aria-valuetext.notes: Forwarded to the nested input; ignored when getAriaValueText is given.

Thumb.getAriaValueText.type: (formattedValue: string, value: number, index: number) => string | null

Value.children.type: (formattedValues: readonly string[], values: readonly number[]) => React.ReactNode

dataAttributes: data-dragging — while the user is dragging (Root, Thumb, Control, Value, Indicator, Track, Label)
data-index — Thumb only, the thumb's index in range sliders
data-valid / data-invalid, data-dirty / data-touched, data-focused (inside Field.Root)

renderProp.elementForm: render={<div />}; the forms handbook composes <Fieldset.Root render={<Slider.Root .../>}> for a labelled range

controlled.note: Generic over Value so number[] ranges and single numbers are both type-safe.

formIntegration.hiddenInput: Each Thumb renders a real <input type="range"> nested in the thumb div, with name/form/disabled/value and aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext/aria-orientation — these are the submitting, validatable controls. Root registers a field control so Field.Root sees the value; the emitted change event has target.value/target.name rewritten for form-library compatibility.
formIntegration.validation: Native range validation (min/max/step) applies through the nested inputs; Field.Root provides the field key.

keyboard.keys: Provided by the nested native <input type="range"> — arrows adjust by step, Page Up/Page Down and Shift+Arrow adjust by largeStep, Home/End jump to the ends. The component reports these as reason 'keyboard'.
keyboard.focus: Each thumb's input is focusable; focus styling is normally written as &:has(:focus-visible) on the thumb wrapper (as the docs' CSS does).

notableDifferences: React Aria's Slider takes a single thumb plus optional SliderThumb list and renders a thumb per value; Base UI requires you to place one Thumb per value and to pass index for SSR of ranges.
React Aria uses isDisabled/isReadOnly (no readOnly here) and value/defaultValue with onChange/onChangeEnd; Base UI uses disabled + onValueChange/onValueCommitted and also has no readOnly.
Keyboard semantics come from a real native range input rather than a custom key map, so Page Up/Page Down/Shift+Arrow behaviour is native.
Rich collision/alignment controls (thumbCollisionBehavior, thumbAlignment, minStepsBetweenValues) have no React Aria counterpart.
State attributes are data-dragging/data-orientation/data-index/data-disabled (React Aria exposes data-dragging/data-orientation too, but the thumb index attribute is Base UI-specific).
